# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class FutureContractRollingAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        # Filter the mapped future to only select contracts that are expanding their front month position.
        self._symbol = self.add_future(Symbol.create_canonical_future("SP_500_E_MINI", market=Market.USA), data_mapping_mode=FutureDataMappingType.LAST_TRADING_DAY, contract_depth_offset=0)
        self.set_filter(self._symbol, FutureFilter.BACKWARDS_RATIO, 0.92)
        # Set the universe settings to use the improved universe selection model.
        self.universe_settings.asynchronous = True
        # Warm up the indicator so it is immediately ready to use.
        self.settings.warm_up_indicator_initial_values = True

    def on_data(self, slice: Slice) -> None:
        if self.portfolio.invested:
            return
        # Create the order for the mapped future.
        mapped_future = self.mapped_futures[self._symbol]
        self.market_order(mapped_future, 1)

    def on_securities_changed(self, changes: SecurityChanges) -> None:
        # Handle the contract rollover.
        for old_contract in changes.removed_securities.get(self._symbol):
            self.liquidate(old_contract, tag=f"Expiry {old_contract.end_time}")
        # Create a liquidate order for the expired contract.
        for new_contract in changes.added_securities.get(self._symbol):
            if new_contract.is_expired:
                continue
            self.market_order(new_contract, -1, tag=f"Rollover {new_contract.symbol}")
